newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Death toll rises to 40 in worst Hong Kong blaze.
newsitem.headline: Death toll rises to 40 in worst Hong Kong blaze.

text.p: The death toll in Hong Kong's worst high-rise building fire on record has risen to 40, police said on Wednesday.
Police said they had found the remains of another body almost a week after the inferno at a 16-storey shop and office block in Hong Kong's Nathan Road "golden mile" tourist shopping district.

The fire, which raged for 21 hours last Wednesday and Thursday, was the worst high-rise blaze in the British colony's history. Preliminary investigations indicated the fire was sparked by welding work in a lift shaft.
